release_notes: Wording that a program writes and a person does not. The home page said "5 bank transaction(s) still need coding" and "1 unpaid invoice(s) are past their due date". So did the reconciliation explanation and the reminder letter. A parenthesised plural is what software writes when it cannot be bothered to decide, and in an application whose whole voice is plain English it was the one line on the page that read like machine output. It was found in the screenshot on the website, which is where a defect like this usually surfaces: not in a test, but in a picture of the product somebody else is looking at. …
